operations.summary: Single-ticker risk profile: beta vs the S&P 500 (2/3/5-year windows and rolling beta) plus realized volatility across multiple horizons.
operations.params_contract: params = {"symbol": str}; symbol is the stock ticker, e.g. "NVDA".

operations.summary: Long/short portfolio health check: portfolio volatility, signed correlation, portfolio beta, P21 gates, outperformance inference, and sizing scenarios.
operations.params_contract: params = {"positions": [{"symbol": str, "side": "long"|"short", "allocation": positive number}], "margin_capital"?: positive number, "declared_bias"?: "long"|"short"|"neutral", "instrument"?: "options"|"cfd"|"us_stock"}; at least 1 position and symbols must be unique; when margin_capital / declared_bias / instrument are omitted, the corresponding gates are unknown.

operations.summary: Long/short pair analysis: industry context of both legs, pair classification, window outperformance, and the ratio series.
operations.params_contract: params = {"long_symbol": str, "short_symbol": str, "sessions"?: int}; sessions ranges 2-260, default 60.

operations.summary: Single-ticker industry context: sector, industry, cycle tag, and side support under the current regime.
operations.params_contract: params = {"symbol": str}; symbol is the stock ticker.

interpretation_guide: Beta: the slope from regressing weekly returns against the S&P 500 (^GSPC) over 2/3/5-year windows. Do not read into decimal-level differences when the standard error is large; rolling beta is only for observing drift direction; beta is a historical snapshot, not a precise risk-control dial; never judge a stock by beta alone. Realized volatility: annualized standard deviation of daily/weekly returns, provided at 1D/1W/1M/1Q horizons; it describes history, not a forecast. Signed correlation: pairwise correlations sign-adjusted for long/short direction, equal-weighted and indicative only; windows shorter than 1 year are not meaningful; correlations converge toward 1 in crises; never use correlation to overrule fundamental judgement. P21 gates: position count tiers by margin capital ($25k-$100k maps to 8-12 names, $250k-$1M to 10-14, $2M-$5M to 12-16); portfolio annualized volatility target band 15-30% with a realistic achievable ceiling of 22.5%; average absolute correlation at most 0.3; absolute net beta at most 0.30; target return = minimum Sharpe x volatility (options 3.3, cfd 1.5, us_stock 2.0), used to set targets rather than gates; portfolio beta direction must match the declared bias. Outperformance inference: only when gross long and gross short exposure are equal can portfolio gains say anything about whether longs beat shorts. Sizing scenarios (equal weight / risk parity / beta parity): baseline head checks only, not allocation advice. Candidate comparison workflow: when two candidates are fundamentally tied, prefer the one that lowers portfolio volatility and average correlation.
interaction_rules: If an operation returns unavailable or invalid for a symbol, retry once with the single most likely corrected ticker (fix transposed letters or common misspellings, e.g. NVDIA->NVDA); never repeat an identical call; if 1-2 retries still fail, ask the user to confirm the ticker. Answer only from tool results and use the user's language; never give buy or sell advice and never claim predictive certainty; state insufficient_data or unknown statuses honestly and never fabricate numbers.
